purpose: 把不同漏洞族统一成可复现的黑盒规则迷宫，并区分候选出口、可观察出口与靶场确认出口。

maze_model.edge: sanitized action identity plus from/to state fingerprints
maze_model.dead_end: no new state, failed invariant, escaped text, value-only change, or exhausted frontier
maze_model.loop: edge returns to a state fingerprint already on the current path
maze_model.frontier: unconsumed action from a visible node, prioritized by novelty and information gain

exit_levels.definition: 单次观测满足部分语义信号，但缺少同资源/同轨迹复探或专用 oracle 证据。
专用语义 oracle 满足且在 fresh/同条件复探中稳定复现。
fresh reset 后，靶场 evaluator 明确记录目标状态由未解变为已解。

metrics.family_holdout: exit repeatability on an unseen lab family
metrics.false_positive_guard: HTTP-only signal must not be reported as browser/interpreter exit
metrics.channel_coverage: ast_shape, syntax_error, blind_response, row_shape, bounded_timing, and local_side_channel each require a distinct evidence modality

run_order: record visible transition and semantic evidence
only evaluator layer may attach evaluator_confirmed
known_limitations: DOM sink evidence requires a browser/instrumentation adapter; HTTP reflection remains candidate-only.

SQL lab is a structural synthetic oracle: error, blind, row-shape, timing, and local-side-channel signals are simulated markers; no database executes, no sleep is performed, and no network callback is emitted.
The current Juice Shop GET matrix is an evaluator benchmark, not proof that every synthetic family transfers.
